unresolvedReferences.reason: family index only; the 9 outdoor records live in separate candidate files daikin-{2mxm40a,2mxm50a,2mxm68a,3mxm40a,3mxm52a,3mxm68a,4mxm68a,4mxm80a,5mxm90a}-outdoor.json; page-52 coverage: 9 OUTDOOR units only (no indoor units on p.52). CRITICAL: p.52 has NO efficiency table -> thermal capacity (Mini./Nom./Maxi.) and electrical input (Puissance absorbée) NOT published for ANY 2/3/4/5MXM-A -> ratings empty for all. p.52 contains a COMBINATION MATRIX (connectability dots per indoor family/size) + outdoor spec table. Matrix dots = CONNECTABILITY eligibility per Daikin, NOT a thermal pairing/rating; captured per unit in compatibility as a connectability note, NOT as invented matched combinations. Blurb: 'Jusqu'à 5 unités intérieures peuvent être connectées à 1 unité extérieure multi'. Outdoor spec: dims 2MXM40A/50A 552x852x350; 2MXM68A 734x958x340; 3MXM40A/52A/68A 734x974x401; 4MXM68A/80A/5MXM90A 734x958x340. Mass 36/41/60,0/57(40A+52A)/62,0/63,0/67,0/68,0. Outdoor sound power cooling only (60 40A+50A; 61,0 2MXM68A; 59,0 3MXM40A+52A; blank 3MXM68A; 61,0 4MXM68A+80A; 64,0 5MXM90A); HEATING sound power NOT published. Outdoor sound pressure Nom./Haute mixed dashes: cooling 2MXM40A -/46, 2MXM50A -/48, 2MXM68A 48,0/-, 3MXM40A 46/-, 3MXM52A 48,0/-, 3MXM68A -/-, 4MXM68A 48,0/-, 4MXM80A -/-, 5MXM90A 52,0/-; heating 2MXM40A -/48, 2MXM50A -/50, 2MXM68A 48,0/-, 3MXM40A 47/-, 3MXM52A -/-, 3MXM68A -/-, 4MXM68A 49,0/-, 4MXM80A 49,0/-, 5MXM90A 52,0/-.
